name: @intloom/meeting-notes
title: Meeting notes
summary: Turn rough meeting notes into a short brief and full minutes with source quotations.

input.prompt: We agreed to pilot with 10% of accounts. The launch date is still open. Chen will share regression results by Thursday.

inputNote: Paste the meeting text or supply one UTF-8 .txt or .md file.
output: Export meeting-notes.md for shareable bullets followed by full minutes in the meeting’s language.
requirements: IntLoom CLI and a configured model with structured output.

name: order-total
title: Order total
summary: Sum a list of integer prices and apply an optional quantity.
inputNote: Provide nonnegative integer prices. Quantity defaults to one.
output: Returns 42 for the input shown. Set quantity to 2 to receive 84.

name: reviewed-report
title: Reviewed report
summary: Write a Markdown report and wait for an explicit review decision.
inputNote: Supply a title and body. Read the saved draft before responding to its review request.
output: Saves report.md and records whether that version passed review. The first run command returns a waiting state.
requirements: No model or credentials required. A review response is needed to finish.
